newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Portugal Treasury may spurn 10-yr OT bids.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Portugal Treasury may spurn 10-yr OT bids.

text.p: The Portuguese Treasury may opt not to place all the 20 billion escudos of 10-year bonds (OT) being offered at auction on Tuesday because yields look set to rise, analysts said.
Analysts said most of the banks bidding at the auction for February 2006 paper were seeking yields above secondary market levels, with some reaching 8.75 percent.
The result is due at 1000 GMT.
At the last sale on July 25, the Treasury placed 15.71 billion escudos at an average rate of 8.6510 percent. The bonds closed at 8.68 percent on Monday on the secondary market.
If bids were much higher than 8.70 percent, some analysts said the Treasury could even opt not to place any paper.
With end-users still out of the market, they said banks felt unable to offer low yields. The Treasury has also made it known that it is not particularly short of funds.
